entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Consider setting MSBuild properties to inform about the presence/absence of global.json in a repo #50660
  • Improve the diagnostic experience when using preview or unreleased SDKs #50659
  • The link present on the installation window are not accessible with any keyboard keys: A11y_.NET SDK and CLI_Uninstall the SDK_Keyboard. #50658
  • [WebToolsE2E] dotnet run of razor app with Release configuration fails with error: "ETag header not found..." #50656
  • Test templates: Revise dotnet.config post action behavior in VS #50655
    10.0.1xx
  • Block `--help` (probably `--list-tests` as well) for MTP when not known by .NET CLI #50654
  • The "Uninstall Successfully Completed" status message is not announced by the screen reader when uninstalling the .NET 9.0 SDK. : A11y_.NET SDK and CLI_Uninstall the SDK_Status Messages #50653
  • Update MSTest templates to 4.0.0-preview.25454.2 #50651

Closed

  • Linux Dotnet 9 Sdk and Runtime Packages missing. #50551

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50664
  • Add LLM environment detection telemetry data point #50663
    consider-for-documentation, Area-Telemetry
  • Fix ASP.NET source generators for non-web projects with FrameworkReference #50662
  • Manually backflow sources from `dotnet/dotnet` #50657
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Update MSTest templates to 4.0.0-preview.25454.2 #50652
    Area-Test templates
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50648

Merged

  • Add dnup manifest + channel parsing #50665
  • Fix tests failing on Full Framework CI #50661
  • Add activity spans for template creation and most tool usage #50163
    Area-Telemetry
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50633
  • [Blazor] Treat `RuntimeIdentifiers` as local property #50487
    Area-AspNetCore, 11.0.1xx

Updated

  • Reuse CSC arguments in file-based app runs #50635
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Update man pages #50559
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add PickBestRid MSBuild task for RID negotiation #50616
    Area-NetSDK
  • Add SelectRuntimeIdentifierSpecificItems MSBuild task for filtering items by compatible RuntimeIdentifier #50615
    Area-NetSDK
  • Support CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting and WindowsSdkPackageMinimumRevision #50264
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Make packtool targets light up only on pack #50445
  • Support `-getProperty` and friends with file-based apps #50530
    Area-run-file
  • A handful of S.CL-related cleanups and reorgs from the OTel branch to minimize diffs #50164
    Area-CLI
  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50403
  • Split 'dotnet test' classes in two directories (VSTest/MTP) #50639
  • Update `.editorconfig` template to set `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups` to `false` #50476
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Common templates
  • Simplify file-level directive diagnostics #50636
    Area-run-file
